title.rendered: AetherSX2 alpha 1.5 – 4248 Apk PS2 Emulator Android Download

content.rendered:
Download AetherSX2 Apk latest version 1.5 – 4248 for Android, which is a new free PS2 Emulator for Android.

AetherSX2 Apk is a new PS2 Emulator, which allows you to run iso game files meant for PS2 console on your Android device with the help of bios file. That means you can run PS2 games with the help of this new emulator.

Although the AetherSX2 PS2 is still in development but, you can run some games or PS2 roms easily without any issues, as time goes on the developer hopes to improve the PS2 emulator.

AetherSX2 emulator has on-screen control button which means you don’t need any external game pad to take control of your game. And it also supports external game pads.

The developer of AetherSX2 said “the emulator can support PowerVR GPUs and even Mali GPU devices” but performance varies based on device specifications. For good performance it is recommended that you have a Adreno device.

From the statement above it means AetherSX2 can run on low end Android device, but for good performance it is recommended that you have a device with more than four CPU and 3 GB ram above.

Features of AetherSX2 on Android 

Here are the features of AetherSX2 on Android:

  • System simulation
  • OpenGL, Vulkan and Software rendering
  • Upscaling of games to 1080p and beyond
  • Wide screen patches for games without native support
  • Save states
  • Touchscreen and bluetooth controller support
  • Games can be loaded from iso/chd/cso disc images
  • Per game settings.
